sn46.23:1.1: “Bhikkhus, by frequently giving attention to things that are a basis for sensual lust, unarisen sensual desire arises and arisen sensual desire increases and expands.
sn46.23:1.2: By frequently giving attention to things that are a basis for ill will, unarisen ill will arises and arisen ill will increases and expands.
sn46.23:1.3: By frequently giving attention to things that are a basis for sloth and torpor, unarisen sloth and torpor arise and arisen sloth and torpor increase and expand.
sn46.23:1.4: By frequently giving attention to things that are a basis for restlessness and remorse, unarisen restlessness and remorse arise and arisen restlessness and remorse increase and expand.
sn46.23:1.5: By frequently giving attention to things that are a basis for doubt, unarisen doubt arises and arisen doubt increases and expands.
sn46.23:2.1: “Bhikkhus, by frequently giving attention to things that are a basis for the enlightenment factor of mindfulness, the unarisen enlightenment factor of mindfulness arises and the arisen enlightenment factor of mindfulness comes to fulfilment by development….
sn46.23:2.2: By frequently giving attention to things that are a basis for the enlightenment factor of equanimity, the unarisen enlightenment factor of equanimity arises and the arisen enlightenment factor of equanimity comes to fulfilment by development.”
